Projectivy accessibility is switched off or crashed
WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS not granted. Run once via ADB: adb shell pm grant io.github.haku4130.noscrollguard android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
Projectivy may need its Display over other apps permission. Tap to restore it.
Reopen Projectivy so it picks the permission up. Tap to open it.
Open Projectivy to wake it up
Its accessibility permission was restored, but Projectivy may need to be reopened. Tap to open Projectivy.
Projectivy Guard cannot wake Projectivy up
The guard\'s own Display over other apps permission was revoked. Accessibility repairs still work, but automatic reopening may fail. Tap to restore it.
